profile.title: Profile
profile.lede: Your name, your email, and the master password that unlocks your vault.
profile.me.title: Name and email
profile.me.hint: If you sign in with SSO, your name and email come from your identity provider: they show here locked and change there.
profile.name: Name
profile.name.hint: Shown to people you share spaces with.
profile.email.hint: You sign in with it. A new address changes once you open the link we send to it.
profile.email.invalid: Type a full address, like name@example.co.
profile.locked.sso: Comes from your identity provider. Change it there.
profile.locked.compatible: This account is shared with Bitwarden apps, which hold its address. Change it in one of them.
profile.locked.noPassword: This account has no master password, so its address can't be changed here.
profile.email.password.hint: Needed to change the address you sign in with. Nothing is sent until you save.
profile.emailSent: We sent an email to {email}. Your address changes once you open the link in it.
profile.pending: Waiting for the link sent to {email}. Your address stays {current} until it is opened.
profile.pending.cancelled: The change of address is cancelled.
profile.proof.hint: You have a second step on, so this change asks for a code too. A code from your authenticator app or your recovery code works, or have one mailed to you. It works once.
profile.pw.title: Master password
profile.pw.hint: Your vault is encrypted again on this device with the new password before anything is sent. The server never sees either one.
profile.pw.new.hint: At least 12 characters. A long phrase is easier to remember.
profile.pw.signOut.hint: They ask for the new master password the next time they open.
profile.pw.noReset: No one can reset it for you.
profile.pw.noReset.body: If you forget it, only your Recovery Kit or emergency access can get you back in.
profile.pw.same: The new password is the same as the current one.
profile.pw.changedOthers: Your master password is changed, and your other devices are signed out.
profile.pw.none: This account has no master password. It opens with a trusted device, a passkey or a Recovery Kit.
profile.pw.compatible: This account is shared with Bitwarden apps, which hold its master password. Change it in one of them.
profile.error.wrong: That is not your current master password.
profile.error.sso: Your identity provider owns your name and email. Change them there.
profile.error.compatible: This account is shared with Bitwarden apps. Change this in one of them.
profile.error.noPassword: This account has no master password to check, so this can't be done here.
profile.error.mailOff: This server sends no email, so an address can't be confirmed. Ask the admin.
profile.error.mailFailed: We could not send the link. Try again in a moment.
profile.error.badRequest: That could not be saved. Check what you typed and try again.
profile.error.changed: Your account changed while this was being saved, so nothing was changed. Try again.
confirmEmail.title: New email address
confirmEmail.done: Your address is now {email}. Every device was signed out, so sign in again with it.
confirmEmail.invalid: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one from your Profile.
confirmEmail.taken: Another account uses that address now, so it can't be yours. Pick another one from your Profile.
confirmEmail.missing: This link is incomplete. Open the one in the email exactly as it was sent.
